# Bundled Notes MCP

Unofficial Python/FastMCP 3 server for Bundled Notes Web. It exposes 43 tools and
supports local stdio plus an authenticated Prefect Horizon deployment.

## Core context

- Runtime: Python `>=3.11`
- Package manager: uv
- MCP framework: FastMCP 3
- Remote entrypoint: `src/bundled_notes_mcp/server.py:mcp`
- Deployment model: one user-owned fork and Prefect Horizon deployment per account; never use a maintainer or third-party endpoint
- MCP authentication: Horizon-managed OAuth
- Bundled Notes authentication: Firebase API key, refresh token, and optional UID assertion
- Upstream transports: Firestore REST, callable functions, and Firebase Storage REST
- Public version discovery: `bundled_status.server_version`
- Schema contract: versioned, sanitized, fingerprinted, and classified as compatible/additive/breaking
- Update semantics: partial patch, post-write re-read, and compensating cleanup
- Live tests: uniquely prefixed disposable records with baseline restoration
- Reminder support: read-only until scheduling behavior is validated end-to-end

## Important files

- `src/bundled_notes_mcp/server.py`: FastMCP instance and entrypoint.
- `src/bundled_notes_mcp/tools.py`: public schemas, annotations, and confirmation gates.
- `src/bundled_notes_mcp/client.py`: domain operations and verification.
- `src/bundled_notes_mcp/auth.py`: Firebase refresh/sign-in and token lock.
- `src/bundled_notes_mcp/firestore.py`: Firestore codec and transport.
- `src/bundled_notes_mcp/storage.py`: upload, metadata, bounded download, and delete.
- `src/bundled_notes_mcp/models.py`: schemas, enums, IDs, and colors.
- `src/bundled_notes_mcp/schema.py`: sanitized observation and drift contract.
- `src/bundled_notes_mcp/overrides.py`: hosted-client compatibility wrappers.
- `docs/README.md`: maintainer documentation index.
- `docs/schema-maintenance.md`: upstream change and official-API migration playbook.

## Commands

```powershell
uv sync --locked --extra dev
uv run ruff format --check .
uv run ruff check .
uv run pytest
uv run fastmcp inspect src/bundled_notes_mcp/server.py:mcp
uv build
```

Use `scripts/schema_audit.py` for read-only drift checks. Run authenticated
`scripts/live_integration.py` only with authorization and disposable test data.

## Security

Every write requires `confirm=true`. Never expose or commit credentials, tokens,
sessions, rollout exports, Firebase responses, note contents, filenames, real
attachments, signed URLs, or account data. Preserve unknown fields, re-read writes,
avoid retrying non-idempotent operations, and keep Horizon payload logging disabled.
